project_type: Next.js 14 App Router with React 18, Prisma ORM, NextAuth, TanStack Query
test_framework: Vitest with jsdom, @testing-library/react, setup in src/test/setup.ts
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm build to ensure TypeScript compiles. 2. Run pnpm test to ensure existing tests pass.
environment_constraints: No database available for runtime testing. No Docker. Validation is via TypeScript compilation (pnpm build) and unit tests (pnpm test).
contribution_requirements: Branch: feat/copy-trading-dashboard. Commit changes but do NOT push.
key_patterns: Client components use 'use client' directive. DEMO_MODE is server-side env var. NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE is needed for client components. API routes check DEMO_MODE for returning mock data. Client components currently initialize state with hardcoded mock data regardless of mode. The fix requires using NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE on client to conditionally show mock data vs empty states with API fetching.
directory_structure: src/app/ - Next.js pages and API routes. src/components/ - React components (dashboard, accounts, groups, trades, metrics, finances, shared, ui). src/lib/ - Utilities, auth, prisma, trading adapters, validations. src/test/ - Vitest test files. prisma/ - Schema and seed.
